landing.headline: Breathe Smarter. Live Healthier.
landing.subtitle: Real-time atmospheric intelligence, deterministic CPCB air quality indices, 48-hour inversion forecasting, and auditable household impact quantification.
landing.fivePillarsSubtitle: A comprehensive end-to-end framework helping families navigate urban smog with physics-based clarity.
landing.description: AeroSense AI empowers families, schools, and communities across India to navigate severe winter smog and urban air pollution with deterministic low-emission routines, indoor air physics, and verifiable Impact Receipts.
landing.fallbackDesc: Interactive 3D acceleration is not available in your browser. Live telemetry data for {cityName} remains fully operational below.

diagnostics.title: Environmental Data Source Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Transparent verification of real-time feeds, deterministic calculation engines, and sensor telemetry.

pillars.sectionDesc: Our own deterministic scientific engines execute all the mathematics. Every quantified recommendation produces an auditable Impact Receipt citing raw data, baseline, and scientific methods.

know.title: Know
know.description: Fused multi-sensor observations (ground stations, Open-Meteo atmospheric profile, and NASA satellite fire anomalies) computed strictly through official CPCB October 2014 breakpoint interpolation.

predict.title: Predict
predict.description: Atmospheric thermal stability models calculate vertical lapse rates at 925 hPa and 850 hPa geopotential heights. Predicts nocturnal smog lids, boundary layer compression, and honest station backtesting.

protect.title: Protect
protect.description: Calculate personalized inhaled PM2.5 mass doses (µg) using EPA Exposure Factors Handbook ventilation rates. Track daily limits against WHO guideline budgets. Stored strictly in browser IndexedDB.

home.title: Home
home.description: Solves the first-order differential equation dC/dt = P·a·C_out + S/V - λC in real time. Know when to seal or ventilate, size your air purifier CADR (m³/h), or build a low-cost Corsi-Rosenthal DIY box.

act.title: Act
act.description: Simulate switching from a petrol two-wheeler to the Delhi Metro, transitioning cooking fuel from biomass to LPG, or running a HEPA purifier. Every quantified claim produces an auditable Impact Receipt.

copilot.title: Fact-Grounded AI Copilot
copilot.tagline: Gemini 2.5 Flash with Zero Number Fabrication
copilot.description: Gemini plans and explains, but never invents science. Every answer is audited by a validator that rejects fabricated metrics and falls back to deterministic rules if unverified.

howItWorks.sectionTitle: Science Done Deterministically. AI for Explanation.
howItWorks.sectionDesc: Unlike ordinary AI chat applications that hallucinate health figures, AeroSense AI enforces a strict boundary: our mathematical engines calculate the physics, while Gemini only explains the verified results.

step1.title: Multi-Source Telemetry Ingestion
step1.subtitle: Open-Meteo • WAQI CPCB • NASA FIRMS • Drone
step1.desc: Continuous raw data acquisition from numerical atmospheric models, ground-level CPCB monitoring stations, and NASA VIIRS satellite thermal detections.

step2.title: Deterministic Scientific Engines
step2.subtitle: Pure Mathematical Models with Zero LLM Call
step2.desc: All science is computed deterministically: official CPCB linear interpolation, 925 hPa vertical lapse rates, EPA exposure doses, and indoor mass-balance ODEs.

step3.title: Auditable Facts Object Assembly
step3.subtitle: FACT-AQI-VALUE • FACT-INV-SCORE • FACT-EXP
step3.desc: Engine outputs are compiled into a strictly typed Facts Object with permanent citation IDs. Numbers not present in this registry can never be cited.

step4.title: Zero-Fabrication Explainable AI
step4.subtitle: Gemini 2.5 Flash + Audited Impact Receipts
step4.desc: Gemini plans and explains recommendations while a strict validator rejects hallucinated figures. Every claim outputs an auditable Impact Receipt.

droneTeaser.title: AeroSense Drone — Aerial Microenvironment Sensing
droneTeaser.description: Our custom UAV payload samples vertical atmospheric columns, identifying surface inversion compression and localized emission plumes before they disperse across neighborhoods.
droneTeaser.honestyNote: *Hardware Honesty: The current prototype utilizes Arduino, ESP8266, MQ-135, and temperature sensing. The MQ-135 is evaluated strictly as a relative gas-response trend and never feeds the official CPCB NAQI. Optical particulate counters and LiDAR are planned future upgrades.
droneTeaser.disclaimer: Software functions completely without physical drone connection.

footer.tagline: Know the air. Predict the risk. Protect your family. Prove the impact.
footer.mission: Clean-Air Decision Engine engineered for PromptWars Challenge 6. All science is executed by pure deterministic mathematical engines; Gemini plans and explains; every quantified recommendation displays an auditable Impact Receipt.
footer.healthNoticeText: Health and exposure estimates generated by AeroSense AI are strictly for environmental guidance, routine planning, and awareness. They do not constitute clinical diagnosis, medical triage, or personal health prescriptions. Consult certified healthcare professionals for medical conditions.
footer.privacyAssuranceText: Family profiles, sensitivities, and bookmarked places are persisted exclusively in your browser's local IndexedDB and are never transmitted to external servers. All outgoing Gemini AI calls are automatically scrubbed of personal identifiers.

overview.cpcbCardDesc: Computed strictly from CPCB October 2014 breakpoint interpolation.
overview.inversionCardDesc: Physical risk score based on 925 hPa lapse rate and boundary-layer height.
